title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75\+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full\-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI\-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

 As part of the Talent Acquisition team, you will have the opportunity to recruit for various areas, across different locations in India, and for simultaneous roles. You’ll work with internal and external candidates, while also contributing to global Talent Acquisition projects and collaborating with colleagues across different regions. In this role, you will partner with our leaders \- hiring managers \& People Operations Business Partners \- to understand the company's culture, current and future hiring needs. You’ll identify potential talent sources, develop strategies to attract the best candidates and ensure a smooth and engaging hiring process.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Tools and processes: Utilize tools and processes in recruitment with full independence. Stay up\-to\-date with recruitment technologies and leverage them to enhance the user experience. Proactively propose improvements to processes and practices. Familiar with POP processes outside of Talent Acquisition domain.
* Recruitment process: Responsible for end\-to\-end recruitment process (including Job Requirement Analysis, Candidate Sourcing and Screening, Interview Process, Offer Management, Background Check) on priority positions with higher complexity. Build and maintain positive relationships with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Take over existing and new positions from scratch.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Build relationships with hiring managers and other stakeholders to understand their talent requirements and ensure effective collaboration throughout the hiring process. Onboard new hiring managers and suggest improvements. Cover multiple Divisions or Departments. Collaborate with managers of different levels of experience in the hiring process.
* Talent Acquisition Program Support: Collaborate with POP colleagues and stakeholders to support talent acquisition initiatives, projects and programs.
* Employer Branding: Understand and promote the organization's employer brand and value proposition to attract top talent. Collaborate with internal or external partners to enhance the organization's reputation as an employer of choice.
* Compliance and Legal Requirements: Ensure compliance with relevant employment laws, regulations, and internal policies throughout the end\-to\-end selection process.
* Industry Research and Analysis: Stay informed about industry trends, salary benchmarks, and competitive hiring practices in talent acquisition strategies. Continuously seek opportunities to enhance talent acquisition processes and approaches based on current trends and research.


**More About You**
* You have at least 8 years of recruiting experience in full\-cycle recruiting for business positions in revenue, sales \& customer facing positions.
* Proven experience in end\-to\-end recruitment processes, including high\-complexity positions at all seniority levels. Preferably on technology environments.
* Proficiency in working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (Workday is a plus).
* Strong sourcing and candidate evaluation skills, with experience using LinkedIn Recruiter.
* Showing adaptability and thrive in managing multiple priorities and roles within a fast\-paced, ever\-evolving environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels


**Important**
 If you have had 2 or more jobs with less than 2 years of experience, we will not be taking your candidature forward. This is a part of our internal hiring policy and cannot be negotiated.
   

  

**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards \& recognition \- A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance\-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements \- We combine in\-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere \- and not always between 9 and 5\.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) \- As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work\-life balance and Well\-being  \- We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development \- Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow \- no matter where you start.
* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
   

  

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
 Read more about our hiring process.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
We are looking for talent acquisition candidates who can participate in our internship program. Candidates who make successful placements will be hired as Talent Acquisition Executives with Industry\-standard salaries. During the internship program, candidates are also eligible for commission\-based remuneration for every successful hire.
 



  





 Role: Talent Acquisition Intern
 



 Experience: Nil / Fresher
 



 Location: Remote (Anywhere)
 



 Internship Period: 2 Months
 



  





 Day\-to\-day responsibilities:
 


* Sourcing, and screening high\-quality candidates from job portals and social media channels
* Talking to the right candidates \& explaining the accurate job description; generating the exact skill\-set of candidates/applicants
* Enable smooth onboarding of candidates by ensuring consistent liaison between your team and candidate pool.
* Scheduling Interviews
* Assist your team in handling end\-to\-end recruitment



  





 Required Skills:
 


* English Proficiency (Spoken \& Written)
* MS\-Excel



  





 Perks
 


* Certificate of Acknowledgement/Experience
* Letter of Recommendation
* Job offer, If found to be an Exceptional Performer

title: Dispatch Associate (URGENT HIRING)
description:
About the job
 



  





 Whiz Delivery is a Canadian last\-mile delivery company operating in Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, and Alberta. We take pride in handling every order with speed, precision, and care. We are seeking a
 **Dispatch Associate to join us immediately** 
 , helping us maintain efficiency, communicate effectively, and take ownership of their role.
 



  





 If you are
 **proactive, observant, resourceful, capable of working under minimal supervision, and have good presence of min** 
 d, this role could be your next big step. We offer the opportunity to grow professionally, acquire new skills, and assume greater responsibility over time, all while being part of an international team.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**Pickup Coordination** 



* Coordinate daily pickups to ensure they run on time and without issues.
* Track order volumes, schedule drivers, and plan efficient routes.
* Assign vehicles and follow up to ensure safety and maintenance standards are met.
* Liaise with truck rental partners when vehicles are required or issues arise.
* Monitor drivers in real time and take quick initiative to resolve delays or incidents independently.



  





**Client \& Team Communication** 



* Communicate with clients and sellers via phone and email to confirm pickup times, provide updates, and manage last\-minute changes.
* Keep internal teams informed to ensure smooth operations between pickups and deliveries.
* Maintain accurate daily records to support transparency and accountability.



  





**Process Support** 



* Keep logs, records, reports, and checklists up to date.
* Assist with delivery dispatch during peak periods.
* Actively share process improvement ideas and take ownership of implementing small improvements to enhance system speed and reliability.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1–2 years of experience in dispatch or logistics coordination.
* Strong English communication skills; Hindi is an asset.
* Must have skills: Observation, Attention to Detail, Responsiveness, and Quick Action.
* Proven ability to take initiative, work independently, and make sound decisions with minimal supervision.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to stay composed in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office.
* Based in India and available during Eastern Standard Time business hours.
* Willingness to follow the Canadian work calendar and holidays, with flexibility for extended hours as needed.
* **Immediate availability to join.**



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work for a growing Canadian company making an impact in logistics.
* Take ownership of meaningful work and grow your career in an international environment.
* Enjoy the freedom of a fully remote role while being part of a collaborative, supportive team.
* Be part of a culture that values initiative, accountability, and getting things done right.



  





**Work Schedule** 



* Monday to Friday: 11 am to 8 pm EST (full\-time)
* Sunday: 12 pm to 3 pm EST (on call)



  





**Compensation** 



* ₹40,000 per month in hand.
* ₹30,000 during the first 1\-month training period.
